central_result: Actual competence is not identifiable from internal observables alone when success depends on an external evaluator/world state not determined by those observables.

A_internal_verifier.claims: verifier-success; actual competence only if soundness established
A_internal_verifier.condition: Y = g(O) for known trusted sound verifier g

B_pointwise_verified.claims: deterministic pointwise competence exactly; stochastic only with repeated outcomes and confidence bound
B_pointwise_verified.condition: fixed task, answer/policy, evaluator, and verified outcome

C_population_verified.condition: outcomes sampled from target distribution or reweighted; trusted evaluator; declared n, eps, delta

D_transfer_generalization.claims: must be labeled verified-on-covered, extrapolated-under-assumptions, or unverified
D_transfer_generalization.condition: additional assumptions or outcome coverage on target region
required: coverage map or explicit regularity/transfer assumptions

minimum_outcome_evidence.deterministic_pointwise: one verified success bit for the exact task/answer/evaluator

positive_internal_case.condition: success predicate is a known measurable function of internal observables

scope: observables, competence, identifiability, minimum outcome evidence
